about: Gabriel India Limited manufactures and sells of ride control products to the automotive industry in India, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers canister shock absorbers, telescopic front forks, inverted front forks, mono shox, floating piston shock absorbers, semi-active front forks, and semi-active shock absorbers; rear shock absorbers, strut assemblies, FSD suspension, semi-active suspension systems, and gas springs; axle dampers, cabin dampers, and seat dampers.
